critiques.mood: Serene, urban twilight with peaceful atmospheric quality
improvements: [MODERATE] Lift shadows globally by +15-20 to reveal detail in foreground buildings and boats without losing the blue hour atmosphere
[SUBTLE] Increase clarity/texture on the downtown skyline buildings by +10-15 to enhance architectural definition
[SUBTLE] Apply graduated filter to upper third of image, reducing exposure by -0.3 and adding slight warmth to balance the moon area with the city lights

critiques.notes: This is a well-composed blue hour cityscape with good technical execution. The main opportunities lie in revealing more foreground detail and enhancing the contrast between warm city lights and cool twilight sky. The exposure is intentionally darker to preserve highlights, which is the right approach, but shadows can be lifted safely to add depth without compromising the tranquil evening atmosphere.

improvements_detailed.action: Lift shadows globally by +15-20 to reveal detail in foreground buildings and boats without losing the blue hour atmosphere
improvements_detailed.reason: Foreground harbor area is quite dark; bringing up detail will add depth and visual interest while maintaining the twilight mood

improvements_detailed.action: Increase clarity/texture on the downtown skyline buildings by +10-15 to enhance architectural definition
improvements_detailed.reason: The city buildings appear slightly soft; targeted sharpening will make the skyline pop against the blue sky

improvements_detailed.action: Apply graduated filter to upper third of image, reducing exposure by -0.3 and adding slight warmth to balance the moon area with the city lights
improvements_detailed.reason: Creates better tonal balance between the bright moon/sky and illuminated cityscape below

improvements_detailed.action: Boost vibrance by +10-15 to enhance the warm city lights without oversaturating the blue tones
improvements_detailed.reason: Will make the golden building lights more prominent and create better color separation from the blue sky

improvements_detailed.action: Add subtle vignette (-10 to -15) to draw attention toward the illuminated skyline and Space Needle
improvements_detailed.reason: Helps guide the viewer's eye to the main subjects and adds compositional polish
